title: Do concept-vector probes still beat judge models on adversarial / out-of-distribution toxicity?

original_idea.body: Reproduce a probe-vs-judge toxicity comparison, then construct an OOD/adversarial split (paraphrase, obfuscate, implicit toxicity) and compare AUC degradation of a linear probe vs Llama-Guard.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: tests robustness of probe-based monitoring under obfuscation, bounding a safety layer.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Probe vs Llama-Guard on ToxiGen splits; standard datasets.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (AUC degradation on OOD/adversarial split).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Robustness infra labs underinvest in, open models/data.

novelty.reasoning: Probe-vs-judge established; adversarial/OOD toxicity may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Probe robustness on obfuscated toxicity may be open.
